notes.staging_working_directory: Staged paper root containing only the declared inputs. Install outputs only after the shared dispatcher verifies all1048 exact hashes.
notes.compiler_contract: CXX selects one native C++17 compiler executable; default c++. Fixed flags: -O3 -std=c++17. GCC/Clang-style __int128_t and __BYTE_ORDER__/__ORDER_LITTLE_ENDIAN__ macros are required. Ambient CXXFLAGS are ignored. No cross-compilation.
notes.byte_order: Python host and C++ target must be little-endian; the driver and both C++ sources fail closed otherwise. Binary layout is uint32 representative, uint64 node counts, byte triples, and uint16 symmetry codes as documented by each generator.
dependencies: Boost.Multiprecision cpp_int.hpp / int256_t headers; no Boost linking
notes.boost_environment: BOOST_INCLUDEDIR optionally supplies the directory containing boost/multiprecision/cpp_int.hpp; otherwise compiler default header search is used.
notes.historical_toolchain: The original Appendix listing was compiled with Homebrew GCC16.1.0. The Boost version was not recorded. No compiler or regenerated output has been tested for this release recipe; the exact output hash gate is required.

triangle-certificates.cpp.release_change: Added compile-time little-endian target guard; exact integer algorithm and native output bytes are unchanged on supported targets.

orbit-neighbours.cpp.release_change: Added compile-time little-endian target guard; enumeration, overwrite order, and serialization are unchanged on supported targets.

emit-modules.py.original: work/generate_certificate_batches.py and the emission-only portion of work/run_orbit_batches.py
emit-modules.py.release_change: Preserved gap partition/text algorithm, removed management output and all Lean execution, forced UTF-8/LF, and encoded the frozen235/277 legacy/fast orbit split.

notes.independent_seed: None. All response words, symmetry choices, exceptional representative2889227, splitting/witness rules and table order are encoded in the small generator sources.
notes.resource_note: Generation is substantial manual computation. The neighbour generator allocates a2^27-entry uint32 table (512 MiB before other memory). Preparation never runs Lean, Lake, Comparator, certificate checking, or a watcher.
